en-168: this guide explains how to install and configure dual light sources on the one laser hydra series. it covers required preparations, rdworks factory settings, verification steps, and how to use the dual-laser configuration in lightburn. note : when configuring dual light sources in the software, make sure that the two lasers are of different types. if the two lasers are of the same type, the motherboard may mistakenly identify them as dual-tube mode, causing both lasers to start emitting light at the same time, thus causing potential safety hazards. preparation material preparation one laser hydra series machine ×1 computer ×1 lightburn or rdworks adjustment steps setting up dual light sources this step can only be completed using the customized version of rdworks. lightburn does not have this function and cannot complete the initial setup. after connecting the machine using rdworks, click "file" in rdworks and enter "factory settings". after clicking "read" button, click "laser" tab. setup laser config: for laser config, select "multi tube" select "laser 1 type" to "glass tube" select "laser 2 type" to "rf laser (preginition)" make sure other config is same to screenshot below (mark as step 4) click "write" and wait until progress complete (mark as step 5) click "read parameters" to confirm that the changes just made have taken effect. make sure that laser type 1 is glass tube and laser type 2 is rf tube co2 (pre-combustion)! check whether the equipment switches the dual light source correctly on the control panel: click menu→alignment→set the burst power to 20%→click to switch the light source, and the laser ① will switch to the laser ② open the back cover of the machine: you can see the reflector will rise: at this point, you can click the shot button on the panel to see if light is emitted: lightburn software connection use set the device type to ruida and connect the machine device setup in the edit menu, click device settings. turn on "enable laser 2 controls", and make sure the "enable laser 2 offset" switch is off and click ok layer parameter settings in the layers menu: "laser 1" is a glass tube laser, and "laser 2" is a radio frequency tube laser: layers that require glass tube lasers: turn on "laser 1"; turn off "laser 2" layers that require rf tube lasers: turn on "laser 2"; turn off "laser 1" important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis.
en-169: the hydra series of lasers come standard with a 2.5-inch focusing lens, with optional lenses available in 1.5-inch, 2.0-inch, and 4.0-inch sizes. this document will guide you on how to replace the different sizes of focusing lenses. preparation onelaser hydra series device*1 focusing lens and focusing lens barrel to be switched distinguishing between different focusing cartridges different focusing lenses fit different focusing cartridges, and the cartridges are labeled with the corresponding lens type. if you need to replace the focusing lens, please make sure you have purchased the appropriate focusing lens and matching focusing lens barrel. instructions for switching the focusing lens remove the focusing lens barrel hold down the air tube connector while pulling the air tube upward. as shown in the figure. loosen the gold-colored nut holding the lens barrel counterclockwise. make sure to hold the laser head with your hand during this process to prevent it from falling. continue to rotate the mirror barrel counterclockwise until the barrel separates from the laser cone head. assemble the new focusing lens barrel the focusing mirror needs to be installed in the barrel. note: focusing lens is mounted with the convex side up. remove the locating rubber ring from the removed barrel and install it on the barrel to be replaced. install the focusing lens barrel to be replaced by tightening it clockwise on the laser cone head. connect the air hose and reinstall the laser head. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis.
en-162: this guide explains how to calibrate the red indicator light so it aligns precisely with the actual laser beam. proper alignment ensures accurate positioning, improves engraving precision, and reduces setup errors during operation. tools you need to prepare m2.5 hexagon socket screwdriver ×1 double-sided tape ×1 machine door cover key ×1 preparations before calibration turn on the machine and move the laser head to the center position of the platform. click menu → alignment → uncheck pulse time → set power to 20%. take a piece of double-sided tape and stick it on the left side of the laser head, then press and hold the “pulse” button (for about 0.5 seconds) to make a spot on the double-sided tape. calibrate the red light path the red light indicator is located at the upper left corner of the platform. you need to use the door cover key to open the upper left door cover of the machine. use a hex screwdriver to rotate the adjustment screw shown in the figure to correct the red light path. when the red light and the light spot are completely aligned, the calibration process is complete. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-163: this guide explains how to connect, calibrate, and use the camera on the one laser hydra series. it covers camera setup in lightburn, importing calibration files, visual positioning, and contour extraction to help you achieve accurate, camera-assisted processing. preparation usb cable ×1 pc ×1 usb flash drive ×1 lightburn software ×1 connecting the machine and the camera 1. connect the usb cable and pc cable to the computer (usb cable and pc cable are stored in the tool pouch) 2. connect the hydra with lightburn, for the connection steps, please click on the link below to watch the tutorial getting started with lightburn: getting started with lightburn: set up & first project note: the origin for hydra is rear left. lt's controller is ruida import camera correction file 1. in the lightburn software, click “window” and “camera control” to enable the camera control function, and then select the camera of the machine. note: please go through the camera screen to make sure that the camera has been selected correctly. 2. right click on “save settings” and select “import camera settings”. 3. please insert the usb flash drive that came with the machine into your computer, save the camera calibration file in the usb flash drive, and then select and import the calibration file. (.lbcm) 4. after importing the camera calibration file, click “save settings” to save the settings. using the camera note: remove the cover of the camera before use. turn off the open cover protection 1. the camera is mounted on the door cover, so you need to keep the door cover open when using the camera. 2. you need to open the lower right door cover of the device, locate the door cover tandem control board, and press the button in the figure below. visual positioning function 1. place the material to be processed on the processing platform of the machine and adjust the focus to a suitable position. note: during the next operation, please make sure that the door cover is always open. 2. then click the “update overlay” button to refresh and display the real-time screen of the machining platform. note: if the laser head is blocking the platform screen, please remove it. 3. import the drawing to be machined and move the drawing to the appropriate machining position. 4. set the machining parameters and size of the drawing. 5. directly click “start” button, the machine will start machining at the set position. physical object pattern contour extraction 1. place the object to be extracted on the processing platform. 2. click “trace” to enter the outline extraction interface. 3. you can use the mouse to select the area you want to extract, and adjust the parameters to extract the contour of the object. 4. after completing the above steps, click “ok” to get the outline pattern of the object. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis.
en-160: this page explains why the laser may fire abnormally when the machine is powered on. it outlines common causes related to incorrect controller wiring or software configuration and provides step-by-step instructions to correct signal connections and factory settings. problem description the laser fires abnormally when the machine is powered on. cause incorrect controller ports: the laser signal cables are plugged into the wrong ports on the motherboard. incorrect software configuration: the laser signal parameters in the factory settings are misconfigured. solution method 1. verify laser signal output connections open the bottom door panel on the right side of the machine to access the controller. check if the terminals are connected correctly according to the wiring diagram. for machines with old firmware: when using a dual light source system, the glass tube and the rf tube must share port ②. when switching between light sources, you must manually unplug the existing signal terminal from port ② and then connect the signal terminal for the other light source. installation tip: ensure the terminals are seated correctly by plugging them as far to the right of the port as possible. for machines with the latest software/firmware updates: please identify and connect the terminals according to the updated configuration below: method 2. verify software laser signal settings connect the machine to your computer and open rdworks. navigate to file > factory settings (password may be required; usually rd8888 ). setup laser config: for laser config, select multi tube, select laser 1 type to glass tube select laser 2 type to rf laser (preginition) make sure other config is same to screenshot below (mark as step 4) click write and wait until progress complete (mark as step 5) critical check: verify that laser type 1 is glass tube and laser type 2 is rf tube co2 (pre-combustion). the switch signal level must be set to high. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-161: this page explains how to properly adjust the x-axis of your laser machine. it covers belt tension balancing and axis alignment to correct skewing, uneven movement, or positioning errors. follow the steps carefully to ensure smooth motion and accurate cutting or engraving results. tools required m2,3,4 hexagonal wrench ×1 5.5mm open-end wrench ×1 note: please complete the following operations under power-off condition and keep the removed screws properly to avoid loss. procedure step 1. adjust the belt (if the belt elasticity is the same on both sides there is no need to operate) set the tension of the belts on both sides to the same level unlock the nut first with a 5.5mm open end wrench. adjust the internal screws with m2 hexagonal wrench, tighten the belt by turning inward, loosen the belt by turning outward. adjusted to check whether the two sides of the belt elasticity is consistent, you can press the belt by hand, and at the same time check whether the gap between the two sides of the screws is consistent. tighten the nut after adjustment. step 2. adjustment of x-axis if the x-axis is skewed on this side, you need to adjust the parts on this side, and similarly if it is on the other side, adjust the other side. unlock this side of the coupling first. loosen the screws on the bottom of the y-axis slider (there are 4 of them). pull the entire x-axis to the bottom, with the bottom aligned with the tensioning seat. hold the x-axis by hand and lock the coupling. lock the screws on the bottom of the y-axis slider. finally, push the x-axis to move and check for anomalies. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-155: this page explains why a laser machine may suddenly stop before a job is complete. it covers the most common causes, including safety triggers, incorrect layer settings, limit switch activation, and memory limitations, along with step-by-step solutions to restore normal operation. problem description the machine suddenly stops during processing, and the laser head ceases all movement before the job is complete. cause door protection triggered: the system detects that a cover or door has been opened, triggering safety mode. layer parameter error: speed settings for one or more layers are set too low (near zero). limit switch triggered: the laser head has hit a physical limit during the movement path. insufficient memory: too many files stored on the device have exhausted the available memory. solution method 1. verify all covers are closed click ok on the control panel to exit the system protection state. ensure all doors and covers are securely closed before starting or restarting a job to maintain a safe working environment. method 2. check layer parameters check if any layer has an extremely low speed setting. if the speed is too low, the laser head may move so slowly that it appears to have stopped. method 3. perform a system reset this is usually caused by a coordinate system mismatch, where the controller's internal position (a, b) does not match the physical position (c, d), causing it to hit a limit switch. press the reset button on the physical control panel to re-home the machine. after resetting, verify that the origin and coordinate system have returned to normal. method 4. check max travel values please verify that the max travel values for the x and y axes in machine settings match your machine's actual work area dimensions. if you are unsure of the correct dimensions, please contact onelaser after-sales support to confirm the factory specifications. method 5. manage device memory memory status cannot be checked directly on the control panel. please connect the machine to lightburn. open the file list via the software and delete old or unnecessary files to free up storage space. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-159: this page explains why the red dot indicator may not appear when the machine is powered on or during operation. it covers the most common causes, including indicator failure, loose connections, or power supply issues, and provides step-by-step troubleshooting to restore the red dot function. problem description the red light indicator is not visible while the machine is powered on or during normal operation. the laser may still function, but the absence of the red dot makes positioning and alignment difficult. cause the red light indicator itself has failed. the connector for the indicator is loose or poorly seated. the tl-timer board is not providing the necessary voltage. solution method 1. check the red dot indicator open the top door on the left side of the machine. locate the red light mounting bracket (near the beam combiner) and check if the red light is emitting light from the source. if the light is on: if you see light at the source but not on the workbed, the reflective mirrors may be dirty or oxidized after prolonged use, failing to reflect the red light. clean and maintain your mirrors. if the light is off: if no light is emitted at the source, proceed with the following electrical troubleshooting: method 2. inspect the indicator connector locate the red light indicator adapter interface (as shown in the diagram) and check for a loose or poor connection. note: the adapter interface is located on the left side of the machine, near the beam combiner. if the connections are secure but the light remains off, test the power supply: open the bottom door panel on the right side of the machine. locate the tl-timer board and unplug the wires indicated in the wiring diagram. set your multimeter to the 5v dc range and measure the output voltage at those pins. if the voltage is 5v: the tl-timer board is working correctly, but the red light indicator component is faulty and needs to be replaced. if the voltage is not 5v: the tl-timer board is faulty and needs to be replaced. support: please contact the onelaser after-sales team to request the necessary replacement parts based on your test results. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-84: problem description during cutting or scanning, the line becomes broken or incomplete, and the laser head fires intermittently. a clicking sound from the machine can often be heard as it attempts to fire. the processing speed and power parameters are set normally. source: image provided by a customer cause computer memory: insufficient system memory or high memory usage causing data packet loss. usb stability: unstable usb connection due to electromagnetic interference. solution method 1. switch connection method restart your computer to free up system memory. connect the machine via ethernet or wi-fi instead of usb. click the links below to view the connection tutorials: connect xt & xrf to lightburn via ethernet connect xt & xrf to lightburn via wi-fi method 2. xt model: low water level or damaged water sensor low water level： open the back panel of the machine to locate the cooling system. look at the water level sensor. if the water is low, you will likely notice that the red light on the sensor is off. add the water until the level reaches the bottom of the neck line. once the water is at the correct level, check the sensor again to see if the red light has turned back on. damaged water sensor： turn off the machine and locate the tl-timing board. unplug the yellow-green wire indicated by the red arrow in the image. then use a conductive material to short-circuit in11 and gnd on the board. after shorting, check whether the laser fault (no beam output) still occurs when running a job. while the machine is running, check the water sensor status. if the status is unclear, record a video and contact the onelaser customer service team for further assistance. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-158: laser replacement is a complete maintenance guide covering both glass tube replacement (xt models) and rf tube replacement (xrf models). this page walks you through safe disassembly, proper installation, and optical path alignment to ensure stable laser performance and long machine lifespan. safety notes the following operations must be performed after power is disconnected . please store removed screws properly to avoid loss. disassembly of the enclosure both xt and xrf models require disassembly of the enclosure. use an m2 hex wrench to remove the screws on the rear cover, then remove the rear cover. glass tube replacement (xt) 1. tools required hex wrench steel ruler water pump utility knife 2. drain the water tank step 1: unscrew the water tank cap counterclockwise. step 2: use a water pump to drain all water from the tank. 3. disassembly of the glass tube step 1: measure the distance from the glass tube to mirror 1 using a steel ruler and record it. step 2: unscrew the positive and negative electrode wires counterclockwise. step 3: use a utility knife to cut the zip ties at the water inlet and outlet , then remove the water pipes. step 4: remove the two screws securing the laser tube and carefully take out the glass tube. 4. install the glass tube step 1: place the new glass tube onto the laser holder and adjust the distance to mirror 1 using the previously recorded measurement. step 2: secure the laser tube with screws and tighten the fixing tape. step 3: reconnect the inlet and outlet water pipes and secure them with zip ties. step 4: reconnect the positive and negative electrode wires. step 5: adjust the optical path (refer to the optical path adjustment tutorial ). rf tube replacement (xrf) 1. tools required hex wrench phillips screwdriver 2. disassembly of the rf tube step 1: unplug the power cable , fan power cable , and signal cable . step 2: rotate counterclockwise to remove the beam expander . step 3: remove the screws securing the rf tube and take out the rf tube. step 4: use a hex wrench to remove the beam expander mirror holder. 3. installation of the rf tube step 1: install the beam expander mirror holder onto the new rf tube. step 2: secure the rf tube to the mounting bracket. step 3: reconnect the power cable, fan power cable, and signal cable. step 4: install the beam expander. step 5: adjust the optical path (refer to the optical path adjustment tutorial ).
en-156: the automatic focusing method uses contact-based focusing. soft materials may affect the focusing accuracy (e.g., sponge, leather). for soft materials, please use manual focusing. you can use 6 mm acrylic to make a focusing ruler. file: 6mm focusing ruler.dxf (104.6kb) manual focus place the material on the honeycomb panel and fix it, then move the laser head above the material. use a focusing ruler to focus. the focus distance is 6 mm . auto focus 1. place the material on the honeycomb panel and fix it, then move the laser head above the material. 2. press the autofocus button on the screen and wait for the focus to complete. note please ensure you only press the autofocus button once for each autofocus operation. since there is no lower limit on the z-axis of the machine, if the honeycomb table is removed, you must place material underneath when using autofocus or pressing down to focus. otherwise, this may cause machine and laser head collisions .
en-157: this guide is designed for makers and businesses engraving cylindrical objects such as tumblers, bottles, cups, and pipes, ensuring accurate rotation, proper focus, and clean engraving results. notice: due to height restrictions, the rotary needs to be used with an optional base. operation steps step 1: remove the four screws with a 2.5 mm allen wrench and take it out. step 2: adjust the drawer installation position according to the height of the rotary and the workpiece. step 3: place the rotary axis on the work platform. step 4: align the groove of the plug with the protrusion of the jack and tighten the screw. step 5: place the material to be processed on the rotating shaft and turn the red knob to fix the material. step 6: move the laser head so that the red light is positioned correctly on the material to complete automatic focusing, then turn on the rotary switch. step 7: after the software connects to the device: ① click laser tools ② click rotary setup ③ enable enable rotary ④ click ok step 8 – further operations ① click edit ② select machine settings ③ save the file ④ click calibrate axis step 9: upload the file, set the origin and border, then start processing. after using the rotary axis, open the machine settings window: ① load the file saved in step 2 ② click ok
en-149: this page explains why engraved text may appear hollow, incomplete, or disconnected during laser processing. it focuses on common lightburn text and font vector issues and provides clear, step-by-step solutions to ensure engraved text is solid, continuous, and production-ready. problem description engraved text samples contain hollow centers (missing fill) or disconnected segments where the lines should be continuous. cause the text pattern settings in lightburn are incorrectly configured or the font vectors are overlapping. solution convert text to path method 1：select your text, then go to the top menu and click edit → convert to path. method 2：select the text, right-click, and choose convert to path from the pop-up menu. why should you convert font to path? if you open the file on a different computer or a different software version that lacks the original font, the system might automatically substitute it, causing deformation or layout errors. converting to a path locks the shape permanently. a path represents the actual physical movement trajectory, whereas a font is a software calculation. converting to a path reduces redundant paths and unexpected jumps, which is critical for fine detail. for mass production, path data is more stable and ensures consistent results across multiple jobs. ⚠️ important note: once converted to a path, the text content can no longer be edited as text (you cannot change the spelling or font). it is highly recommended to keep a original text version backup file before converting. weld shapes if your text appears hollow because the characters overlap, you need to merge the overlapping vectors. method 1：select the converted path, then go to the top menu and click tools → weld shapes. method 2：select the path and find the weld shapes icon in the left-hand toolbar. test result comparison important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis.
en-153: how to connect external blower explains how to safely connect an external air blower to a laser machine for improved ventilation and cutting performance. this guide covers preparation, required tools, and step-by-step installation to ensure proper airflow and reliable operation. 1. preparation ① consumable preparation one laser x model device ×1 m2 hexagon wrench ② debug software none 2. operation step ① use an m2 hexagon wrench to loosen the six screws on the right side panel and remove the side panel. ② press the blue air valve to draw out the built-in air. ③ insert the external air tube into the blue air valve nozzle. ④ insert the external air pipe into the air nozzle valve and turn on the external air compressor.
en-152: backlash and scan offset issues can cause misaligned lines, blurred engraving, and uneven results . this guide explains how to adjust backlash parameters using lightburn, including preparation, test file setup, scan offset tuning, and verification to achieve clean, accurate engraving. note the reverse clearance of the equipment has been adjusted to the best engraving effect before leaving the factory. please do not adjust it at will unless you encounter special circumstances. at the same time, the engraving reverse clearance parameters tested by the manufacturer are on the aluminum foil sheet that comes with the machine, which can be directly filled in. 1. preparation ① material preparation aluminum foil pieces magnifier ×1 one laser x series device ×1 computer ×1 ② debug software lightburn 2. adjustment steps ① open the software click edit → device settings to enter the device settings interface. ② in the machine settings interface a. click basic settings , check enable scanning offset adjustment , and click add to add a speed parameter (set according to personal processing needs) b. first fill in the speed parameter 600 (according to personal needs). do not fill in the offset parameter. set line shift = 0 , then click ok after completing the settings. 3. importing test files a. click file → import , select the file, and click open note: this test file needs to be provided by the manufacturer’s technical staff. 4. set processing parameters a. double-click the processing parameter status bar to set the engraving parameters. b. set: engraving speed: 600 mm/s line distance (lines per inch): 50 after setting, click ok to confirm. c. upload the file to the device for processing. 5. equipment processing a. place the aluminum foil on the platform, adjust the focal length, then position and process along the border. speed: 600 mm/s offset value: 0 b. as shown in the picture, the line offset is particularly obvious and will affect the actual engraving result. from top to bottom: odd-numbered line segments are used as reference even-numbered line segments are biased to the right you need to increase the offset parameter to make the lines basically overlap. 6. changing the offset parameters a. follow the above steps to fine-tune the offset parameters between 0.05 – 0.3 mm . during the adjustment process, continuously observe the engraving effect to ensure the best setting. b. after increasing the offset, the lines are roughly aligned, but the even-numbered line segments are slightly biased to the left. at this time, slightly reduce the offset until all lines are basically aligned. c. reduce the offset parameter, save, and upload the drawing again. after adjustment, upload the drawing again for processing. result it can be seen that the odd and even line segments basically overlap, and the adjustment is completed.
en-150: this guide provides a step-by-step explanation of laser power supply replacement , covering both xrf switching power supplies and xt laser power supplies . it outlines required tools, safety precautions, disassembly steps, wiring instructions, and correct installation to ensure safe and reliable machine operation. note: please keep the disassembled screws properly to avoid loss. before unplugging the cable, please take a photo to record the connection status to prevent incorrect wiring during reinstallation. tools that need to be prepared hexagonal wrench m2 & m3, cross screwdriver (xrf) disassemble the casing ① ensure that the device power is disconnected. ② use an m2 hex wrench to unscrew the screws on the back cover of the device, and then remove the back cover. ③ unscrew the screws on the right cover plate. xrf switching power supply replacement disassemble the switch power supply ① use a hex wrench to unscrew the screw that secures the switch power supply. ② use a phillips screwdriver to remove the installation bracket for the switch power supply. ③ use a phillips screwdriver to disconnect all the wires connected to the switch power supply, and then remove the switch power supply. install switch power supply ① fix the new switch power supply on the casing and connect the wires. ② install and fix the casing. xt laser power supply replacement disassemble the laser power supply ① rotate counterclockwise to unscrew the positive and negative wires. ② pull out the terminals of the power and signal wires. ③ unscrew the screw that secures the laser power supply with a hex wrench to remove the laser power supply. install laser power supply ① fix the new laser power supply onto the casing. ② connect the terminals of the positive and negative pole lines, power line, and signal line. ③ install and fix the casing.
en-151: this guide provides a step-by-step walkthrough for control card replacement in laser machines. it covers safety precautions, required tools, enclosure removal, control board disassembly, proper cable handling, and reinstallation to ensure stable operation and prevent wiring errors. note: before unplugging the cable, please take a photo to record the connection status to prevent incorrect wiring during reinstallation. keep the removed screws in a safe place to prevent loss. tools required hex wrenches (m2 & m3), phillips screwdriver 1. removing the machine enclosure ① ensure that the device power is disconnected. ② use the m2 hex wrench to remove the screws on the rear cover, then take off the cover. ③ remove the screws on the right-side panel. ④ before removing the right-side panel, disconnect the following cables: emergency stop switch power cable touchscreen signal cable pm2.5 detector power cable 2. removing the tl-time control board ① disconnect the connectors shown in the image. ② remove the two network cables from the switch. label the cables before removing them as shown in the image. ③ remove the two screws shown in the image. this will allow you to move the tl-time control board aside. 3. replacing the control board removing the old control board ① disconnect all cables from the control board. ② use a screwdriver to remove the four screws securing the control board. installing the new control board ① remove the outer casing of the control board using a phillips screwdriver. ② secure the new control board to the enclosure and reconnect all cables. note: do not miss any connectors. (the image shows an incorrect connection with a missing terminal.) 4. reassembling the machine restore the tl-time control board, switch, and enclosure to their original positions, following the connections made before disassembly.
en-148: this document offers a comprehensive guide to the functions of each button on the control panel, ensuring a thorough understanding of their operations. how to use the display control panel button functions start the job display of working hours and coordinates of x, y and z axes stop / cancel the job pulse button frame button autofocus button spare button the laser head moves to the top in the x-axis direction the laser head moves to the top in the z-axis direction the laser head moves to the left in the y-axis direction origin button the laser head moves to the right in the y-axis direction spare button the laser head moves down in the x-axis direction the laser head moves down in the z-axis direction main interface menu interface memory interface reset button menu interface functions enter the ip address setting interface enter the switch language interface restore factory parameters backup current parameters enter the diagnostics interface keyboard lock to prevent being touched by mistake enter the laser head movement settings interface enter the pulse settings interface system version information interface notes this interface is the memory file interface . select the file you want to engrave or cut and click “ok” , then it will switch back to the home interface. click the start button to run the corresponding job. the usb flash disk function is not available for the time being. if any alarm pop-up window triggers, the pop-up window will appear every 1 second after it is closed until the error is resolved.
en-147: testing the optimal focal length is a critical step to achieve sharp engraving, clean cuts, and consistent laser results . this guide walks you through how to test the optimal focal length using a dot test method, covering required tools, file setup, and preparation steps before running the test. tools required rdworksv8 software, dot test focal length file, pc data cable, limestone board download the focal length test file right-click the following file and select “save to file” to save the test file on your computer hard drive. focal_length_test_file.rld test the focal length 1. start the device and connect it to the computer using a pc cable. 2. launch rdworksv8 software and connect to the device. 3. click sequentially: config >> system settings >> set map for pen axes to “z” 4. open the focal length test file and click “download” to transfer the file to the device. 5. place the wood board on the processing platform and press the material flat. 6. move the laser head to a suitable processing position, then click sequentially: positioning >> start >> process the drawing 7. after processing is complete, observe the wood board and find the smallest spot. this is the optimal focal point, and the number to the right of the spot is the focal length. note the focal length of each device is different, please refer to the actual test results for accuracy. set the focus parameters refer to the diagram below and click sequentially: user >> other >> read >> enter the focal length >> write this completes the focus setting.
en-144: switching focusing lenses is an essential skill for laser engraving and cutting users who want to optimize engraving detail, cutting depth, and material performance. this guide explains how to switch between different focus lenses on xrf and xt series laser machines , including what lenses are supported and how to prepare before making the change. 1. preparation work ① consumables preparation one laser series equipment ×1 one focusing lens to be replaced ×1 ② debugging software none 2. switching to a different focusing lens ① removing the focusing lens i. remove the front cover of the laser head ii. remove the focusing lens seat iii. you can use a tool to secure the notches on the ring, then rotate counterclockwise to unscrew the retaining ring, thereby removing the focusing lens. ② installing the focusing lens in the correct position i. the focusing lens mount has designated installation positions for both 2.0-inch and 2.5-inch focusing lenses. install the focusing lens in the correct position according to your needs. the 2.5-inch focusing lens is installed on the top . the 2.0-inch focusing lens is installed at the bottom . attention only one focusing lens can be installed on the focusing lens mount at a time. the focusing lens should be installed with the convex side facing up.
en-143: working environment requirements co₂ glass tube laser engraving and cutting machines are sensitive to ambient temperature. low winter temperatures can adversely affect the normal operation of the equipment. therefore, appropriate protective measures should be taken to ensure stable performance. to ensure optimal performance of your laser cutting machine year-round, it's crucial to maintain a suitable storage environment. the room temperature should be between 60°f and 80°f (15°c and 27°c), with a humidity level of 40% to 70%. avoid exposing the machine to direct sunlight. cooling system to ensure optimal performance, the operating environment temperature should be maintained between 15°c and 25°c. extremely low temperatures can cause the coolant to freeze, affecting heat dissipation and potentially damaging the laser tube. laser machines typically use either air or water cooling, with the specific cooling method depending on the laser model. air cooling the 1laser xrf series of lasers utilizes rf tubes as the laser source and employs an air cooling system for heat dissipation. air-cooled tubes utilize fans to circulate air over the tube’s heat sinks, facilitating cooling. the system temperature cannot fall below the ambient room temperature. freezing is typically not a concern due to the absence of water. water cooling xt series lasers employ water-cooled glass tubes that are susceptible to sub-freezing temperatures. optimal system operation requires a water temperature range of 15°c to 25°c. if outdoor temperatures fall below freezing, precautionary measures must be taken to prevent laser tube damage. note that warranty does not cover freezing-related damage. the chiller must be filled with distilled water or pure water. freeze mitigation provide a constant temperature environment for the workspace here are some fundamental ways to protect your water-cooled cooling system from freezing: maintain operating temperature: avoid excessively low operating temperatures. consider using heating equipment if necessary. prevent cold air intrusion: ensure cold air cannot enter the system. if needed, disconnect the exhaust duct from the outdoor environment. drain the coolant in case of a prolonged power outage in winter or when the equipment is idle for an extended period, it is essential to completely drain the coolant from the chiller and its associated piping. add antifreeze coolant we use pure distilled water in dc-excited glass water-cooled tubes due to its low conductivity, which allows for the safe passage of 30,000 volts of electricity through the tube. additives can interfere with this conductivity and potentially damage the cooling system components, particularly over extended periods of use. 🔗 onelaser approved antifreeze use a water heater you can actively warm the water up with a water warmer. be sure to set the temperature setpoint of warm to below the chiller’s setpoint by at least 2 degrees celsius.
en-139: switching focusing lenses allows you to optimize engraving depth, detail, and cutting performance based on your project needs. this guide explains which lenses are compatible with the xrf and xt series and walks you through the safe steps to remove and replace the focusing lens. note the xrf & xt series can only switch between 2.0-inch and 2.5-inch focusing lenses. the xt series comes standard with a 2.0-inch focusing lens. the xrf series comes standard with a 2.5-inch focusing lens. removing the focusing lens step 1: remove the front cover of the laser head. step 2: remove the focusing lens seat. step 3: you can use a tool to secure the notches on the ring, then rotate counterclockwise to unscrew the retaining ring, thereby removing the focusing lens. installing the focusing lens in the correct position the focusing lens mount has designated installation positions for both 2.0-inch and 2.5-inch focusing lenses. install the focusing lens in the correct position according to your needs: the 2.5-inch focusing lens is installed on the top. the 2.0-inch focusing lens is installed at the bottom. note: only one focusing lens can be installed on the focusing lens mount at a time. the focusing lens should be installed with the convex side facing up. 2.5 inches installed on top 2.0 inches installed on bottom
en-140: this guide explains how to safely replace the control panel on your onelaser device. you’ll find important safety notes, required tools, and step-by-step instructions to ensure proper removal, installation, and reconnection of all necessary cables without causing wiring errors. note: before unplugging the cable, please take a photo to record the connection status to prevent incorrect wiring during reinstallation. keep the removed screws in a safe place to prevent loss. tools required hex wrenches (m2 & m3), phillips screwdriver 1. removing the machine enclosure ① ensure that the device power is disconnected. ② use the m2 hex wrench to remove the screws on the rear cover, then take off the cover. ③ remove the screws on the right-side panel. ④ before removing the right-side panel, disconnect the following cables: emergency stop switch power cable touchscreen signal cable pm2.5 detector power cable 2. remove the control panel use a phillips screwdriver to unscrew the screws in the picture below to remove the control panel. 3. reinstall the machine ① re-fix the new control panel onto the chassis. attention: the signal cable interface of the control panel should face the pm2.5 detector and should not be installed upside down. ② connect the emergency stop switch power cord, control panel signal cord, and pm2.5 detector power cord. ③ install the casing and secure it with screws.
en-138: to ensure the normal operation of the one laser xt model, please note that the cold water pump equipped with this device is used to cool the glass tube. the water in the water tank of the water pump has been drained at the factory. if it is powered on directly without adding pure water, it will directly cause electrical failure. therefore, after receiving the device, please add pure water to the water tank of the water pump as soon as possible to ensure the safe operation of the device. 1. preparation ① consumable preparation one laser xt model device*1, m2 hexagon wrench ② debug software none 2. operation step ① remove the back cover of the device note: the left door of the device needs to be removed at the same time. use an m2 hexagonal wrench to remove the hexagonal screws on the back cover and left door of the device and place them together. take out the back cover of the device ② fill the water tank with pure water note: using pure water as cooling water can prevent scaling and corrosion, improve cooling efficiency, and inhibit the growth of microorganisms, thereby effectively protecting the equipment, ensuring its stable operation and extending its service life. find the location of the water tank open the water filling cap on the top of the water tank and pour in about 790ml of pure water. older models: start the equipment, after the pump is started, immediately pour in about 790ml of pure water, observe while pouring, until the water in the storage tank flows into the glass tube. after has flowed into the tube, you need to add another 150ml or so of pure water, and once you have done so, put the filler cap back on and tighten it . new model: the new model of the device in the water tank outside the water level detection, to prevent the device pump dry burning led to damage. pour in about 790ml of pure water, start the device and wait for the water to flow in, after flowing into the tube, you need to add another 150ml or so of pure water, after joining, put the water filler cap back on and tighten it . ③ antifreeze ratio note: to ensure the normal operation of the device in a low temperature environment, when the indoor temperature drops below 10 degrees celsius, be sure to add antifreeze to the water tank in proportion. if antifreeze is not added, the low temperature may cause abnormalities in the glass tube of the device, thereby affecting the normal operation of the device. ratio diagram: proportion (anti-freeze fluid : distilled water) room temperature (unit: °c) 3:7 -12 ~ -15°c 4:6 -22 ~ -25°c 5:5 -32 ~ -35°c 6:4 -42 ~ -45°c according to the ratio of pure water and antifreeze shown in the figure above, pour in pure water first, then add antifreeze. care instructions: the antifreeze fluid will deteriorate to a certain extent when it is used for a long time. after the antifreeze fluid deteriorates, it will be more corrosive and the viscosity will also change, so it needs to be replaced regularly. the frequency of replacement we recommend is to change the water once every 2-3 months (at room temperature). when the ambient temperature starts to rise and the sub-zero temperature is lifted, the circulating cooling water can be replaced with softened water such as distilled water or purified water. try to use the same brand of antifreeze. even if the main components of different types of antifreeze are the same, their additive formulas will be different. it is not advisable to mix them to avoid chemical reactions, precipitation or bubbles. if laser machine will not be used for a long time, the water inside of laser tube, chiller and water pipes should be drained out, especially for glass laser tube. if buyer did not carry out our instruction, any broken of laser tube caused by this will not be guaranteed. ④ post-processing after the water tank is filled with water, please reinstall the rear cover and side door of the device.
en-137: this page explains common reasons why the lifting lead screw fails to raise the mirror mount and provides practical inspection and maintenance steps to restore normal operation. it addresses abnormal noise, stalling during upward movement, and control panel error prompts related to the lifting mechanism. problem description initially, there may be a slight noise when the mirror mount moves toward the rf tube position. this noise increases over time with continued use. the control panel displays a no extend device error prompt. the mirror lifting lead screw moves downward normally (switching from rf to glass tube), but stutters or stalls when moving upward (switching from glass to rf tube). currently, the mirror mount requires a manual upward push to successfully rise. cause the mirror lifting lead screw has not been cleaned or lubricated regularly. connections related to the lifting mechanism are loose or disconnected. the lifting lead screw is slightly bent or misaligned. solution method 1. cleaning and maintenance use a cleaning agent, compressed air and high-quality lubricant to clean and maintain the lifting lead screw assembly. after maintenance, try switching the laser source to see if normal operation is restored. method 2. inspect wiring refer to the wiring diagram below to check all related cables for looseness, disconnection, or physical damage. ensure all plugs are seated firmly. method 3. check lead screw verticality and alignment a bent lead screw will cause resistance at specific points in the travel. with the power turned off, manually rotate the lifting lead screw to move the mirror mount up and down. feel for any significant resistance as the mount passes through different positions. if resistance is felt at a specific height, the screw may be bent or out of alignment. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-132: this page explains why random stray lines may appear during laser processing, even when they are not present in the original design file. it provides a detailed breakdown of common causes—ranging from data transmission errors to hardware failures—and step-by-step solutions to help restore stable and accurate machine operation. problem description a file that previously ran normally now causes the laser head to move randomly along the x or y axis, leaving random stray lines that do not exist in the original design. in some cases, the laser head may even continuously crash into the x-axis or y-axis limit switches during operation. source: image provided by a customer cause clicking start directly in lightburn can cause errors if the data stream is interrupted. if the computer is running on high memory, data packets sent to the machine may be lost. damaged switches may send false triggers. loose, burnt, or damaged plugs on the x/y drivers, or loose connections at the motor ends. internal damage to the x or y axis motors. solution method 1. send files to the machine problems caused by clicking start directly in lightburn are almost always due to an unstable live transmission. instead of start, click send in lightburn to transfer the file completely to the machine’s internal memory. then, initiate the job directly from the machine's control panel. method 2. clear computer memory computers can accumulate a large amount of cache after long periods of operation, which may interfere with data processing. restart your computer to release memory and clear the cache. after rebooting, try sending the file and running the job again. method 3. inspect limit switches open the diagnose page on the controller panel. manually press the limit switch with your finger. check if the corresponding indicator on the diagnose page changes from green to red. if the color changes: the switch is functioning correctly. if the color remains unchanged: the limit switch is damaged and needs replacement. method 4. inspect the x-axis or y-axis driver disconnect the power. unscrew the screws on the right side of the xrf and remove the right side cover. locate the x-axis/y-axis driver (near the back end of the machine) and check for any loose or burned connections at the driver plug: if the plug is loose: push the plug in tightly, ensuring a secure connection. then, try moving the x-axis or y-axis. if the plug is burned: take photos and contact customer service via zoho to request a replacement for the damaged driver plug (if the machine is still under warranty). prepare a multimeter and set it to continuity mode . turn the machine off and unplug the wires from the driver. use the multimeter probes to check continuity on: ① black and yellow & green wires ② brown and blue wires the multimeter should beep or display "0l" to confirm continuity. the diagram below illustrates checking the y-axis driver as an example. method 5. inspect the x-axis or y-axis motor locate the x-axis motor and verify the wire plug is securely connected. open the cover at the back of the honeycomb board to locate the y-axis motor . check if the wire plug is connected and if the motor is functioning. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-135: introduction the automatic focusing method uses contact-based focusing. soft materials may affect the focusing accuracy (e.g., sponge, leather). for soft materials, please use manual focusing. you can use 6mm acrylic to make a focusing ruler manual focusing manual focusing is ideal for materials that may compress, bend, or warp under pressure. follow the steps below for accurate results: 1. position the material place the material on the honeycomb table, ensure it is flat, and secure it to prevent movement. 2. place the focusing ruler slide your 6mm acrylic focusing ruler directly underneath the laser head. this sets the correct focusing distance between the nozzle and work surface. 3. adjust the platform height use the machine’s height adjustment control to raise or lower the platform until the laser head just lightly touches the focusing ruler. once the head makes contact, the focus is set. automatic focusing automatic focus is fast and convenient for most materials, especially hard, flat surfaces. 1. position the material place the material securely on the honeycomb table and move the laser head above it. 2. initiate auto focus on the touchscreen, select “focus” → then tap “ok” . the machine will lower itself until the contact sensor reaches the correct height. ⚠️ important note when using automatic focus, the material must be placed on the table. running auto-focus without material underneath can cause the sensor to overtravel, potentially damaging the laser head or table.
en-136: this page provides a clear overview of how dual-source laser systems combine the strengths of rf tubes and glass tubes to deliver superior cutting and engraving performance. you’ll learn how each tube type contributes to precision, power, efficiency, and material versatility—making dual-source machines an ideal solution for diverse production needs. preface in the field of non-metal material processing, the dual-source laser cutting machine has become an ideal choice for many enterprises due to its unique design and outstanding performance. it cleverly combines the advantages of rf tubes and glass tubes, meeting a wide range of processing needs and significantly improving processing efficiency and economic benefits. complementary advantages of rf and glass tubes rf tube the rf tube can produce high-quality beams and fine spots, making it suitable for precision processing. whether it's intricate pattern engraving or high-quality edge cutting of materials, the rf tube can perfectly reproduce details, making it ideal for crafting fine arts and electronic components. glass tube the glass tube boasts higher power and stronger penetration, excelling at quickly completing large-area cutting tasks. although its cutting quality is slightly inferior to that of the rf tube, it is sufficient for basic needs and has certain advantages when cutting thicker materials. flexibility in handling different material thicknesses for thin material processing, such as fabrics and leather, the fine spot of the rf tube can prevent excessive cutting damage, ensuring the quality of the finished product. for cutting thick materials like thick acrylic boards and bamboo or wood products, the high power and penetration of the glass tube can easily handle the task, meeting basic cutting requirements. power control and processing precision the rf tube has excellent power control precision, capable of low-power output, which meets the needs of precision engraving and other fine processing tasks. in contrast, the glass tube cannot output low power, making it unsuitable for processing tasks that require high precision in power control, which can lead to substandard processing quality. enhancing processing efficiency and economic benefits reducing equipment costs compared to purchasing two different types of laser cutting machines, the dual-source cutting machine has a lower equipment cost. enterprises do not need to buy separate machines for different processing needs, saving a significant amount of investment. this also reduces the space occupied by equipment, allowing for more efficient use of production areas. reducing equipment switching during the processing, the dual-source cutting machine can quickly switch light sources on the same machine, greatly reducing the time and labor intensity of equipment switching, and improving production efficiency. it also minimizes the risk of errors caused by equipment switching, ensuring the stability and reliability of the processing process. increasing processing speed by reasonably allocating light source usage according to processing needs, such as using the rf tube for precision areas and the glass tube for large areas or low-precision areas, the machine can maximize processing speed while ensuring quality, meeting the high demands of enterprises for production efficiency.
en-133: this page explains how to troubleshoot a situation where the machine cannot work normally and all indicator lights are off . power-on issues are commonly caused by switch problems, loose wiring, or power supply interruptions. follow this guide to quickly identify and fix the cause. problem description the machine cannot work normally and all indicator lights are off. solution method 1. emergency stop switch are off gently pulling up vertically to turn the emergency stop switch on. method 2. the switch wiring is not tight use an m2 hexagonal wrench to remove the side door of the device and check whether the wiring has fallen off. if it falls off, re-secure the wire. method 3. please check if the external socket has power. method 4. the power cord is damaged use the multimeter to check the power cord. put the red probe of the multimeter into contact with the pin of the male plug, and the black probe into contact with the pin at the other end, one by one, gnd to gnd, l to l, n to n. when connected, the multimeter will beep and the value will change. not connected state if it is not connected, please contact the manufacturer to replace the power cord. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-134: when using lightburn to transfer files, you may encounter a pop-up message saying “file transfer failed.” this guide explains the most common cause—usb communication failure—and provides step-by-step instructions to check your usb driver and restore proper connectivity. problem description when using lightburn to transfer files, the software displays a pop-up window with the warning "file transfer failed". solution method 1. check if the usb driver is successfully installed and running properly go to the computer device manager, click the port, and right-click properties to check whether the driver is successfully installed and running normally. method 2. check if the usb cable is damaged use a multimeter, switch the gear to the on/off position, touch the red test lead to the a terminal, and the black test lead to the b terminal, and look at the display of the multimeter to determine whether the usb cable is connected or disconnected. not connected connected (the value on the multimeter will change and there will be a beep) method 3. check whether the usb port of the motherboard is abnormal use an m2 hexagonal wrench to remove the right door of the device. find the motherboard and unplug the usb cable that was originally inserted. directly plug in the usb cable provided with the device if the device can be connected and used normally the usb extension cable from the internal board of the device to the external usb interface is damaged. please contact the manufacturer for replacement. if the connection cannot be used normally please check whether the usb extension cable from the internal board of the device to the external usb interface is normal. → use a multimeter, switch the gear to the on/off position, touch the red test lead to the a end, and the black test lead to the b end, and look at the result of the multimeter to determine whether the usb expansion interface is on or off. not connected connected (the value on the multimeter will change and there will be a beep) if the test is normal the mainboard is damaged and you need to contact the manufacturer to replace the mainboard. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-128: poor processing effect is a troubleshooting guide that helps users identify and resolve issues where laser cutting fails to cut through the material. this page explains the most common causes—from material conditions to optical path alignment—and provides practical inspection and adjustment steps to restore proper cutting performance. problem description during laser cutting, the material cannot be cut through , even though the job appears to run normally. solution method 1. material issues the material surface is uneven, coated or has impurities that will affect the cutting effect. make sure the material surface is clean and flat, and pre-treat it if necessary. method 2. the reflector or focusing mirror is completely damaged failure to maintain the equipment on time may result in the reflector or focusing lens not being able to transmit or reflect light. check whether the light path reflector and lens have good light transmittance. method 3. laser optical path deviation the laser light path is offset, which will cause the laser to hit the inside of the laser head or the inside of the device, and the light cannot be emitted. please use double-sided tape to stick on the three-mirror frame, and press the point shooting to check whether the light spots of the five light source points in the platform overlap. if there is an offset, please refer to the “ how to adjust the laser light path ” . method 4. incorrect focus adjustment the bending of the material itself and the inconsistent height of the working area will cause different focal lengths at different positions in the cutting area, especially when cutting large-format patterns. please use a strong magnet to flatten the material and use a focusing ruler to check whether the height of each area of the working platform is consistent. if it is not accurate, please use the focusing ruler to readjust the focal length . method 5. laser is weak or damaged the laser life has reached its limit, resulting in a decrease in light output power. the laser life is usually between 2500–4000 hours , and the specific life depends on the actual operating conditions. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-131: when your device cannot connect after the network cable is plugged in, it usually indicates a network configuration issue. this guide explains the most common cause—ip setting errors—and provides simple steps to ensure your computer, software, and device share the same network segment for proper communication. problem description the device cannot be connected after the network cable is plugged in. solution method 1. ip setting error after the device is connected to the network cable, please check whether the computer local ip, software ip, and device ip are in the same network segment. if they are inconsistent, please set the first 3 digits of the ip segment to be consistent. method 2. network cable is damaged use a network cable tester to test whether the network cable is damaged. determine whether the network cable is damaged according to the indicator lights on the network cable tester. turn on the switch, and the indicator lights on the main tester and the remote test end should flash from 1 to 8 in sequence. if the indicator lights flash in sequence, it means that the straight-through network cable has good connectivity. if they do not flash in sequence, it means that the network cable is not connected and needs to be replaced. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-129: this guide explains how to adjust the laser light path on the onelaser x series safely and correctly. it covers critical precautions, required tools, and preparation steps to help ensure accurate alignment while preventing unnecessary damage or time-consuming recalibration. note: when the device leaves the factory, the optical path has been precisely adjusted to the best state. if you are not sure whether the optical path of the device has shifted, please do not adjust the optical path lens knob or locking screw at will . once the optical path locking screw or knob is adjusted, the optical path of the device may shift. if it shifts, you may need at least 4 hours to readjust the optical path of the device. 1. preparation ① material preparation double-sided tape × 1 10mm acrylic × 1 flathead screwdriver × 1 m3 hexagon wrench × 1 m2.5 hexagon wrench × 1 m2 hexagon wrench × 1 one laser x series × 1 ② disassembling the case a. removing the back cover use an m2 hexagon wrench and carefully remove the screws according to the instructions in the picture, and place them in a unified manner. b. removing the front cover use an m2 hexagon wrench and carefully remove the screws according to the instructions in the picture, and place them in a unified manner. c. removing the side door use an m2 hexagon wrench and carefully remove the screws according to the instructions in the picture, and place them in a unified manner. ③ set panel parameters a. set the burst parameters a. click on the menu → laser setting → setting parameters b. set the burst mode to continuous , the time to 5 ms , and the power to 30% . 2. adjustment steps note: please stick the double-sided tape on the front of the frame to be adjusted, then move the laser head and lightly press the shot button to adjust the optical path. during this process, please carefully observe the changes in the optical path. ① adjust the light path from one reflection to two reflections stick the double-sided tape to the front of the second mirror frame. that is, adjust the light source points ① and ③ as shown in the figure below to coincide with each other. a. adjust the overlap of ① and ③ light spots when a large deviation occurs, such as the following: a. large offset adjustment at this moment, the light spot is offset to a large extent, and it is necessary to adjust the bottom bracket to make the light spots roughly overlap. after loosening the fixing screws of the black bracket, start adjusting the upper reflective frame. during the adjustment process: fix the screws while fine-tuning the frame ensure the light spots roughly overlap after tightening the screws on one side, check if there is any deviation observe the direction of movement of the light spot when tightening push the frame in the opposite direction accordingly fix the frame until the lenses roughly overlap the light spots roughly overlap: b. adjust lens distance tighten the three gold nuts on the outside of the lens and the lens will move back, ensuring there is about 1 cm gap between the lens and the frame. if the distance between the lenses is about 1 cm , there is no need to tighten the nut again . c. loosen frame nut use an m2.5 hexagon wrench to loosen the silver-white nut of the frame. d. adjustment instructions in the figure: when screw no. 1 is rotated clockwise, the light source will move downward when screw no. 2 is rotated clockwise, the light source will move to the right when screw no. 3 is rotated clockwise, the light source will move to the upper left (counterclockwise rotation will move the light source in the opposite direction.) after each fine-tuning of the screw, please slightly tighten the silver-white nut to prevent the light source from shifting a second time. adjust these three screws until the front and rear light sources coincide at the same point . 3. adjust the optical path from the second reflector to the third reflector stick double-sided tape to the front of the three-mirror frame. this step adjusts the light source points ①, ②, ③, and ④ so they overlap and are positioned at the center point. a. adjust ① and ② light source points to basically coincide a. use an m2.5 hexagonal wrench to loosen the two fixing screws of the second mirror frame. b. move the frame: gently move the second mirror frame, move the laser head back and forth, and press the point shooting button to let the laser hit light source points ① and ② . after the front and rear light spots appear on the third mirror frame, fix one screw and gently swing the second mirror frame to make light source points ① and ② basically overlap. after overlap, tighten the screw. b. adjust the overlap of light source points ①, ②, ③, and ④ a. use an m2.5 hexagonal wrench to loosen the two silver nuts on the frame. b. adjustment instructions: when screw no. 1 rotates clockwise, the light source moves downward when screw no. 2 rotates clockwise, the light source moves to the right when screw no. 3 rotates clockwise, the light source moves to the upper left counterclockwise rotation moves the light source in the opposite direction after each fine-tuning of the screw, slightly tighten the silver-white nut to prevent the light source from shifting again. adjust these three screws until ①, ②, ③, and ④ light sources overlap. c. adjust ①, ②, ③, ④ light source points to the center point a. when there is a left-right deviation from the center point, adjust it by adjusting the two-mirror frame use an m2.5 hexagonal wrench to loosen the two silver nuts. gently push the second mirror frame: if biased to the left, move it to the right if biased to the right, move it to the left adjust until the light source is centered. b. height deviation adjustment when there is a height deviation from the center point, the laser height needs to be adjusted. i. use an m2.5 hexagonal wrench to loosen the two jacking bolts on the laser base. rf tube: turn the knob clockwise to raise the laser tube, counterclockwise to lower it. glass tube: a
en-126: this page provides a step-by-step troubleshooting guide for resolving issues where the touchscreen becomes stuck after powering on the machine and cannot enter the main interface. it covers common causes such as switch status, cable connections, hardware faults, and firmware mismatches, along with corresponding solutions. problem description after turning the machine on, the touch screen panel has been stuck in this page and cannot enter the main interface. solution method 1. rotary switch are on please turn off the rotary switch and then try to reboot the machine again. method 2. the unstable connection between the touchscreen panel and the motherboard ensure that the machine power is disconnected. then use the m2 hex wrench to remove the screws on the rear cover and take off the cover. remove the screws on the right-side panel. before removing the right-side panel, disconnect the following cables: emergency stop switch power cable touchscreen signal cable pm2.5 detector power cable reseat the connector between the panel and the control board. method 3. control board or touchscreen panel fault if the issue persists after trying the above methods, please replace the component with a new one for testing. method 4. incorrect firmware version installed remove the right-side panel of the machine and inspect the label on the motherboard. ensure that the motherboard and hmi firmware updated files you downloaded exactly match the version indicated on the label. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
en-127: this page provides a step-by-step troubleshooting guide for resolving wi-fi connection issues when the machine operates normally but cannot establish a wireless connection. it explains common configuration errors, connection mistakes, and hardware checks to help restore stable wi-fi communication. problem description note: to ensure file transfer efficiency and stability, please avoid transmitting data via wi-fi through thick walls or heavy obstructions. the machine is operating normally, but a wi-fi connection cannot be established. solution method 1. incorrect switch module settings an incorrect channel setting on the internal switch module will prevent the wi-fi from connecting. use a 2 mm hex wrench to remove the 6 screws from the right-side door of the machine and locate the switch module. ensure that button 1 is pressed down. button 1 activates channel 1 (wi-fi mode), which allows the computer to connect to the machine's wi-fi hotspot. method 2. incorrect wi-fi connection please verify that you are connecting to the correct network: direct connection: if you are connecting to the machine’s local hotspot, verify the name follows the format: machine model + hotspot + last 5 digits of serial number . bridged connection: if you have bridged the machine to an upstream router, ensure your computer is connected to that same wi-fi. connecting guide: connect xt&xrf to lightburn via wifi method 3. inspect the wi-fi receiver and components check for hardware damage or loose connections: check if the green indicator light on the wi-fi module is illuminated. if it is off, verify that the power supply is functional and the network cable is properly plugged into the controller board. ensure the network cable is securely seated in its port. ensure the power supply wire for the module is tightly connected. important reminder: if these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on zoho: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket . a technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
